title: Pastel Muses
overview:
Popping sound balls feels great!! "Pastel Muses" is here!!

Sound action puzzle

In this music-themed puzzle game, Puchamaru and Panako hop on a launcher and send colored balls arcing down a sloping playfield. Hold the button longer to jump higher and shoot farther, then touch three or more balls of the same color to pop them. Balls left unsupported roll downhill and can set off chain reactions, but let a ball cross the boundary line and you lose.

- One-Player Muse: a story mode against six opponents, with a map to choose your stages
- Battle Muse: split-screen two-player versus with handicaps
- Challenge Muse: an endless mode with new stacks of balls pushing in
- Time Muse: clear every ball in each stage before time runs out
